headline: Revenue surges as profitability swings back to positive
summary_short: Everpure's (formerly Pure Storage) fiscal Q1 revenue rose 35.2% y/y to $1.05B on FlashArray/FlashBlade demand and Evergreen subscription growth, and the company swung to $24.1M net income (EPS $0.07) from a $14.0M loss a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue grew 35.2% y/y to $1.05B on higher FlashArray/FlashBlade demand, pricing, and hyperscaler royalties, plus 17% growth in subscription services revenue. Product gross margin improved on pricing/mix; subscription margin dipped slightly on Fusion/Azure-native amortization and higher compensation. Opex rose across R&D, sales and G&A on headcount-driven compensation growth. Net income swung to $24.1M (diluted EPS $0.07) from a $14.0M loss a year ago; other income fell on higher FX losses, while the tax provision dropped on OBBBA Section 174 R&D-capitalization relief. Subscription ARR reached $2.04B (+19% y/y); Q1 buybacks were $84.1M under the $1.8B repurchase program. No forward guidance is given in this 10-Q.

drivers.explanation: Product revenue growth was driven by higher customer demand for FlashArray/FlashBlade across geographies, increased pricing and, to a lesser extent, hyperscaler royalties; subscription growth came from higher Evergreen consumption and renewals.

Product margin rose on price increases and mix shift toward higher-performance systems and hyperscaler royalties; subscription margin slipped slightly on capitalized-software amortization and higher compensation costs.

Swing to higher operating income reflects revenue growth outpacing opex growth; R&D, sales and G&A each rose primarily on higher headcount-driven compensation, per the filing's expense-line commentary.
